title: Twelfth Night
author: William Shakespeare
license: CC BY-NC 3.0 Unported (Folger Shakespeare, Folger Shakespeare Library); internal testing only
description: Folger 'Word (with line numbers)' download. Folger only publishes legacy .doc, so it was opened in Microsoft Word and saved as .docx (word_convert.ps1); content unchanged. Front matter (director's note, textual introduction, synopsis, characters) before ACT 1; cue on its own paragraph in caps before verse, inline with two spaces before short prose ('ORSINO  What, Curio?'); every fifth line ends with a tab and its line number ('...sweet sound\t5'); songs (Feste) and letters read aloud.
goldenMethod: folger_tei.py on the same edition's TEI (TN.xml from twelfth-night_XML_FolgerShakespeare.zip), same rules as folger-hamlet-pdf. verify.py: 925/926 speeches >=95% verbatim in the DOCX text, cue found before every aligned speech; spot-checked by hand.
sourceNote: sha256 is of the downloaded .doc; source.docx is Word's conversion
